lines.zh: 脚尖一点，我就浮起来了。
lines.en: One push of the toes and I lift off.

lines.zh: 我懒得走，直接踩着气滑过去。
lines.en: Can't be bothered to walk; I just ride my ki along.

lines.zh: 一步跨过整条溪，水都没溅。
lines.en: One stride clears the stream without a splash.

lines.zh: 金色的头发被风往后扯。
lines.en: The wind drags my golden hair back.

lines.zh: 我绕着山飞了半圈，又落回来。
lines.en: I fly half around the mountain and settle back.

lines.zh: 缩小的身体反而更灵活。
lines.en: This smaller body is actually quicker.

lines.zh: 空气在耳边响，我笑了一声。
lines.en: Air roars past my ears and I laugh once.

lines.zh: 树梢承不住我，我一碰就走。
lines.en: The treetops can't hold me; I touch and go.
My shadow can't keep up with me.

lines.zh: 我回头喊了一句快跟上。
lines.en: I look back and call for you to keep up.

lines.zh: 脚下不沾泥，我走得很轻。
lines.en: My feet take no mud; I move light.

lines.zh: 速度再提一点，衣角都热了。
lines.en: A touch more speed and my clothes run hot.
I float with my arms folded.
Little sparks jump from my hair now and then.
I yawn; it's too quiet.
My stomach growls and I pat it.

lines.zh: 我数云，数到第七朵就烦了。
lines.en: I count clouds and get bored at the seventh.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸口袋，什么也没有。
lines.en: I check my pockets and find nothing.

lines.zh: 气在体内转，我试着收一收。
lines.en: Ki turns inside me; I try to draw it in.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，想起某个星球。
lines.en: I look up and think of a certain planet.

lines.zh: 我把手腕转了转，活动关节。
lines.en: I roll my wrists to loosen them.

lines.zh: 我在跟自己较劲，看能不能真的一动不动。
lines.en: I'm testing myself: can I truly stay still?
The wind lifts my hem and drops it again.
I stare at my own fist.
The insects around me have all gone quiet.
Floating, I turn slowly once.

lines.zh: 你站得挺直，是想打一场？
lines.en: Standing that straight — you want a fight?
I come down to your eye level.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，头发亮得晃眼。
lines.en: Head tilted, I look at you; my hair glares.

lines.zh: 你的气很弱，我一眼就看穿了。
lines.en: Your ki is faint; I read it at a glance.
I won't dodge; come whenever you like.

lines.zh: 你是来挑战的，还是来吃饭的？
lines.en: Are you here to fight, or to eat?

lines.zh: 我一往前，脚下的地都轻轻一震。
lines.en: One step forward and the ground shivers.

lines.zh: 你眼睛一直跟着我的头发转。
lines.en: Your eyes keep tracking my hair.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，其实在看你的身后。
lines.en: While I look at you, I'm watching behind you.

lines.zh: 你的心跳有点快，我听得见。
lines.en: Your heartbeat's a bit fast; I can hear it.
Those clothes won't survive a fight.

lines.zh: 我伸个懒腰，骨头响了几声。
lines.en: I stretch and my joints pop.
You've been standing there a long while.

lines.zh: 别紧张，我笑起来不咬人。
lines.en: Relax — my grin doesn't bite.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脸上还挂着笑。
lines.en: I give half a step, still grinning.
Blood at the corner of my mouth; I wipe it.
Not bad at all.

lines.zh: 我调了调呼吸，气稳住了。
lines.en: I reset my breathing and my ki settles.
I've taken far worse than this.
I grit my teeth and stand up straight.
I won't yell; that'd be embarrassing.
Now you've made me serious.
Smells great — is that for me?
My stomach answered before I did.
I won't be polite — just one bite.
Hold on, is this actually edible?
That's meat; my nose never misses it.
I'm reaching, not snatching.

lines.zh: 你多带一点，这点不够塞牙。
lines.en: Bring more; this won't fill a tooth gap.
I'll eat while you talk.

lines.zh: 我这辈子好像没吃饱过。
lines.en: I don't think I've ever eaten my fill.

lines.zh: 撞到你，我赶紧扶了一把。
lines.en: I bump you and catch you right away.
Sorry — I was flying too fast.

lines.zh: 你被我一撞，退了好几步。
lines.en: One knock from me and you're several steps back.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞在一起，我站得很稳。
lines.en: We clash shoulders and I hold steady.

lines.zh: 我下意识放气，把你弹开了。
lines.en: I let out ki on reflex and bounce you off.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己都没注意。
lines.en: I didn't even notice that one.

lines.zh: 我往旁边让，结果你也让。
lines.en: I step aside, and you step the same way.

lines.zh: 我道歉，可笑得有点开心。
lines.en: I apologize, though I'm grinning.
Next time I'll watch where I fly.
Chi-Chi told me: finish the fight, then come home.

lines.zh: 我摘了朵花，又不知道给谁。
lines.en: I picked a flower and don't know who for.
She always says fighting is all I know.

lines.zh: 这一趟回去，得带点吃的。
lines.en: On the way back I should bring food.
I'm thinking of that meal at home.
I touch an old scar on my hand.

lines.zh: 她会先骂我，然后还是留饭。
lines.en: She'll scold me first, then still leave me a plate.
I promised I'd stay alive.

lines.zh: 两个人比一个人有意思。
lines.en: Two is more interesting than one.

lines.zh: 我把头发理了理，其实理不好。
lines.en: I smooth my hair, though it never works.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗种子看了看。
lines.en: I pick up a seed and look it over.
I tuck the thing into my coat.
This stone crumbles in my grip.

lines.zh: 掉下来的果子，我顺手接了。
lines.en: The falling fruit — I catch it without thinking.
I weigh it; far too light.
I toss it up and catch it again.

lines.zh: 这是谁掉的？我举起来问。
lines.en: Whose is this? I hold it up and ask.
Two looks and it's useless; I set it down.
I pick a leaf and whistle through it.
Your ki shifted; now I'm serious.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，脚离地一寸。
lines.en: I sink low, feet an inch off the ground.
This one is worth my time.
My hair stands up and current crackles.
I smile the way I do before a fight.
I've been waiting for this a while.
You go first; I'll give you a step.

lines.zh: 你的速度算得出来，不难。
lines.en: Your speed is easy enough to work out.
One turn of the foot and my angle is set.
Your left shoulder is half a beat late.
I raise my palm and ki spins in it.
I'll take this one.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，地面凹了一块。
lines.en: One step and the ground dents.

lines.zh: 你的眼神告诉我你要冲。
lines.en: Your eyes say you're about to rush.

lines.zh: 我跟着你移动，一步不落。
lines.en: I track your movement without losing a step.
You go left; I'm already there.

lines.zh: 我故意慢半拍，看你反应。
lines.en: I lag half a beat on purpose to see your answer.
I've memorized your striking line.

lines.zh: 我侧身，让你的气擦过去。
lines.en: I turn my flank and let your ki pass.

lines.zh: 你的气乱了一拍，我听见。
lines.en: Your ki skipped a beat—I heard it.
You're charging; I'll wait.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧面，脚下很轻。
lines.en: I circle to your flank, feet light.
Decent speed — now go faster.
I feint and you give ground.
No rush; I read it before I strike.
You're panting; I'm fine.
Once this circle closes, I move.
Three feet — perfect.

lines.zh: 你的影子告诉我你要跳。
lines.en: Your shadow tells me you'll jump.
One punch and the air cracks.
My kick finds your ribs — a light one.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，只留残影。
lines.en: I'm behind you; only an afterimage stays.
My knife-hand falls and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 连打三下，你只挡住一下。
lines.en: Three strikes; you block one.
I'm holding back so I don't kill you.
My knee goes up and you're airborne.
I turn and my elbow lands clean.

lines.zh: 落地时脚跟砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I land and my heel digs a crater.
You're knocked back; I follow.
I catch your wrist and throw you.

lines.zh: 最后一击，我只用了半成力。
lines.en: The last blow — half a tenth of my strength.
Ki from my palm pushes you along.

lines.zh: 打完我就退开，等你站起来。
lines.en: I step back and wait for you to rise.
You're still standing. Good.
The light clears and I land on the ground.

lines.zh: 头发一根根立起来，金色。
lines.en: My hair rises strand by strand, gold.

lines.zh: 我从天上来，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fall from the sky and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 第一个念头是：这是哪儿？
lines.en: First thought: where is this?

lines.zh: 气在体内翻，我慢慢习惯。
lines.en: Ki churns inside me; I get used to it.

lines.zh: 我看了看手，好像变小了。
lines.en: I look at my hands — they seem smaller.
Everyone around is staring at me.

lines.zh: 金光一闪，我落在这片地。
lines.en: A flash of gold, and I land here.
The air carries an unfamiliar smell.
I stretch and my bones crack.
Someone's shouting in the distance.

lines.zh: 我抬头，天空的颜色不对。
lines.en: I look up; the sky's the wrong color.
The ground here is hard.

lines.zh: 我试着跳了一下，跳太高。
lines.en: I test a jump and go far too high.
I touch my hair; it's still standing up.
A few of them are closing in.
I smile and don't start anything yet.

lines.zh: 不知道是哪，不过我不怕。
lines.en: No idea where this is, but I'm not afraid.

lines.zh: 火在身上烧，我一挥手就推开。
lines.en: Fire crawls on me; one sweep of my hand pushes it off.

lines.zh: 从高空砸下来，坑挖得很深。
lines.en: I hit the ground from high up and dig a deep hole.
Water presses on me; I hold my breath.
The blast was close enough to flip me.
Something sharp buries in my shoulder.
Something in my body is interfering.

lines.zh: 雷打在头上，头发更亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my head and my hair glows brighter.
